description: Area di circolazione ciclabile is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendata.comune.siena.it. The longitudinal part of the road, duly delimited, reserved for the circulation of cycles.The cycle path may be carried out:a. on its own, single or double direction of travel, if its seat is physically separated from that relating to motor vehicles and pedestrians, through suitable longitudinal traffic divides physically insurmountable;b. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling area" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include urbanistica, territorio. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt. Current Toscana metadata was checked on 9 October 2026 and links this same municipal layer under a suffix-2 identifier. The earlier listing and its historical links remain preserved; version equivalence remains unverified.
